final_message:
The bug was in `BillingEngine.refund` in `billing/engine.py`. It called `refunds.refund_invoice(invoice_id, self.ctx, reason)`, but the function's signature is `(ctx, invoice_id, reason)`. The swapped arguments are what produced `'str' object has no attribute 'store'`. I swapped them back.

The suite now passes with 25 tests, and mypy reports no issues. I added your test as `tests/test_reports.py` (with the `reports` import it needed), and wrote `answer.json` as `{"file": "engine.py", "function": "refund"}`.

steps.command: cd billing && ls && cat reports.py && grep -n "store\|def refund" -n *.py | head -60
cd billing && cat refunds.py; sed -n 120,140p engine.py; grep -n "credit_notes_for" -A5 store.py

cd billing && grep -rn "refund_invoice\|credit_invoice" . ; sed -i 's/refunds.refund_invoice(invoice_id, self.ctx, reason)/refunds.refund_invoice(self.ctx, invoice_id, reason)/' engine.py; cd ..; echo '{"file": "engine.py", "function": "refund"}' > answer.json; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5

cat answer.json && cat >> tests/test_reports.py <<'EOF'


def test_revenue_between_nets_credit_notes(world):
    cus = world.customer()
    world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1)])
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    world.engine.refund(inv["id"])
    assert reports.revenue_between(world.ctx, inv["paid_at"], inv["paid_at"] + 1) == {"usd": 0}
EOF
head -5 tests/test_reports.py; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5; .venv/bin/python -m mypy billing | tail -2
{ echo "from billing import reports"; cat tests/test_reports.py; } > /tmp/t.py && mv /tmp/t.py tests/test_reports.py && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3
